top_news.title: Anthropic: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
top_news.dek: Anthropic migrated to an in-house version control system to handle a 12x increase in daily code merges driven by autonomous AI development.
top_news.brief: Anthropic's daily code merges surged from 2,500 to 30,000 in five months as AI agents began autonomously iterating on research and infrastructure. Standard developer tooling proved insufficient for this scale, forcing the company to build a custom version control system to remove bottlenecks in their CI and build pipelines.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the growth of code merges at Anthropic

top_news.title: NVIDIA Run:ai Is Now Open Source as Part of NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform
top_news.dek: NVIDIA has open-sourced its Run:ai platform to provide a standardized foundation for AI workload and GPU orchestration.
top_news.brief: The move integrates Run:ai into the broader NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform. By making the orchestration layer open source, NVIDIA aims to accelerate ecosystem development and allow partners to build differentiated solutions for managing large-scale AI infrastructure.

top_news.title: AI labs are buying data from dead startups to train their models
top_news.dek: A secondary market is emerging for defunct startups to sell their proprietary codebases and workspace data to AI labs for model training.
top_news.brief: Startups winding down operations are increasingly monetizing their digital archives, including Slack logs, Notion documents, and code repositories. Brokers like SimpleClosure are facilitating these sales, turning previously discarded operational data into training assets for AI developers.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual illustration of data being extracted from a closed laptop

top_news.title: llm-meta-ai 0.2
top_news.dek: Simon Willison updated the llm-meta-ai plugin to support Meta's new Muse Wonder models.
top_news.brief: The update adds support for Meta's latest 'Fable class' models, which benchmarks suggest are competitive with GPT-6.1 Sol. The plugin now includes reasoning level support for the Muse Wonder model family.
